summary: Tested the bug fix for 'Go to Meeting Schedules →' button navigation in SupervisionMatrix.js. Verified that clicking the button from the empty state (no schedules) correctly navigates to /admin/schedules instead of the broken /schedules path.
critical_code_review_comments: SupervisionMatrix.js line 200: navigate('/admin/schedules') confirmed correct - fix verified
Note: The /admin/matrix URL redirects to /supervision-matrix in the actual app routing - this is expected behavior (route registered under /supervision-matrix)

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Both admin and manager navigation verified

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: SupervisionMatrix.js 'Go to Meeting Schedules →' button now correctly navigates to /admin/schedules. Tested with both admin and manager roles. The Supervision Matrix page is accessible via sidebar link 'Supervision Matrix' which routes to /supervision-matrix (not /admin/matrix). The empty state shows when 0 schedules exist.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: navigate('/schedules') had no matching route in App.js, causing React Router to fall through to the catch-all which redirected to /dashboard. Fix: changed to navigate('/admin/schedules') which is the correct registered route. Verified fix works for both admin and manager users.
